items.text: Jeremiyah Love projected 4.8 DK points clear of Allgeier; gut says much better role this week despite prior Week 4 usage criticism and ankle maintenance, though downside risk remains if he tells coaches it's been a long year. Not on final IR.
items.why: Not on final report + expected response to usage drag; bigger workload than last week
items.implication: Startable RB with clear lead over Allgeier in projections

items.text: Love love LOVE Nico Collins @ TEN; ranks as WR8.
items.why: Target-hog volume including red zone vs weak Titans pass D

items.text: Chris Olave and Dallas Goedert listed IN.
Fear ways it can go sideways long-term for Malik Nabers: knee becomes real issue, can't shake shoulder, JJ McCarthy under center, or coaching boomer-up; short-term still good play but stacked risks.
items.why: Sore knee + frustration over targets + multi-factor stack
items.implication: Monitor closely; long-term caution even if plays this week

items.text: Hates Jalen Hurts vs JAX in London as QB15; rough stretch and banged-up line.
items.why: Recent form + OL issues + London + missing weapons (Barkley/Smith)
items.implication: Fade or sit if better options
items.conflict: volume still possible but efficiency risk
